perks.name: Recycled Energy
perks.desc: Reloading after defeating targets grants energy to your lowest charged ability.

perks.name: Subsistence
perks.desc: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Grave Robber
perks.desc: Melee final blows or dealing damage with a charged melee reloads this weapon's magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: To the Pain
perks.desc:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage increases handling and aim assist until the weapon is stowed.

Taking more damage increases the effect.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.desc: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Overflow
perks.desc: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo automatically loads this weapon beyond normal capacity.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.desc: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

perks.name: Target Lock
perks.desc: Damage increases the longer this weapon remains on a target.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: Sword Logic
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

perks.name: Permeability
perks.desc: Using your class ability changes this weapon's damage type to match your equipped Super until you stow the weapon.

perks.name: Offhand Strike
perks.desc: Final blows grant additional weapon range, stability, and accuracy when firing from the hip for a short duration.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.desc: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

perks.name: Willing Vessel
perks.desc: Dealing damage or defeating targets with this weapon gradually grants increased stability, handling, reload speed, and charge rate. This effect gradually decreases over time but is gained more quickly while near allies.

perks.name: Runneth Over
perks.desc: Reloading near allies overflows the magazine. Bows receive faster draw time and Swords receive faster charge rate.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Arguably the best addition this episode, Mirror Imago has some sweet perks. Subsistence, Grave Robber, or Overflow all limit downtime on reloads. Hatchling for those Strand junkies. Sword Logic or Target Lock for those other...lesser subclasses." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Over in the crucible You have my favorite archetype of SMG. Sword Logic will transfer over easily being one of the best perks for Mirror Imago. Offhand-Strike is fun but not high meta." Recommended MW: Range.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 135 from 25 March 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/5JwIN3avdyW27aRjv4Zb2D?si=21b247e788174887) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for use against Minor adds in general at-level or better content, particularly with melee builds. If you don't already have a well-rolled melee build SMG or are looking for a replacement for an older one without an origin trait, then Mirror Imago could work but, if you do, you can safely give it a pass. At base, the stats are okay - 42 Range and 14 Zoom equates to 18.24m ADS and 13.03m hipfire, 46 Stability is ×1.1731 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 52 Handling is 0.35s ready, 0.26s ADS and 0.32s stow speed, 50 Reload Speed is a 1.82s reload, Recoil Direction is 99 and magazine size is 36 (max 41). Use the barrel perk for Handling on M+KB or Stability for controller, although you might also find a little extra range useful, and the magazine perk can be used to provide a bit more reload speed or extra rounds. For melee builds, there are a few options in the first trait perk column, Pugilist is the obvious one, returning melee ability energy on kills, but Grave Robber is useful for an instant refill of your magazine with a melee kill or a hit with an elemental melee, or Recycled Energy (when it's a bit less buggy) will probably be useful for gaining ability energy to your lowest charged ability when reloading after a kill. In the second column, Swashbuckler is your damage perk for up to a ×1.33 boost for 4.5s at five stacks or after a melee kill. If you're interested, Mirror Imago is a technique in relationship therapy aimed at fostering a deeper relationship and connection. Willing Vessel is a useful, if unspectacular origin trait to boost gunfeel stats in the background as you hit and kill targets, but if you're in a fireteam, and manually reloading, Runneth Over will overfill your magazine by an additional 10% (rounded up) for each Guardian you're within 15m of. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Strand Tangles or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader. Also, don't forget to check whether there's a useful Seasonal Fragile mod for the activity you're running.
